facts.fact: The Standard reports that the ODPC, established under the Data Protection Act, 2019, is the regulator overseeing compliance with Kenya's data protection law (document gives no event date; published 2026-07-22).
The Standard reports that Data Commissioner Immaculate Kassait led the ODPC's launch of an ISO 9001:2015 quality management system on 14 July 2026, showing the office constituted and acting.
